name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

env:
  AWS_REGION: us-east-1
  ECR_REPOSITORY: cloud-native-app
  EKS_CLUSTER: cloud-native-app-cluster

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cd .github/workflows/cloud-native-app/App
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cd .github/workflows/cloud-native-app/App
        pytest

  build-and-push:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Configure AWS credentials
      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v3
      with:
        role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}  # From Terraform output
        aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
    - name: Login to ECR
      run: |
        aws ecr get-login-password --region $AWS_REGION | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin $492413876690.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com
    - name: Build and push Docker image
      run: |
        cd .github/workflows/cloud-native-app/App
        docker build -t $ECR_REPOSITORY:$GITHUB_SHA .
        docker tag $ECR_REPOSITORY:$GITHUB_SHA $492413876690.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com/$ECR_REPOSITORY:$GITHUB_SHA
        docker tag $ECR_REPOSITORY:$GITHUB_SHA $492413876690.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com/$ECR_REPOSITORY:latest
        docker push $492413876690.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com/$ECR_REPOSITORY:$GITHUB_SHA
        docker push $492413876690.dkr.ecr.$AWS_REGION.amazonaws.com/$ECR_REPOSITORY:latest

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-push
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Configure AWS credentials
      uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v3
      with:
        role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN }}
        aws-region: ${{ env.AWS_REGION }}
    - name: Update kubeconfig
      run: aws eks update-kubeconfig --region $AWS_REGION --name $EKS_CLUSTER
    - name: Update kustomize image tag
      run: |
        sed -i 's/newTag: latest/newTag: '$GITHUB_SHA'/' .github/workflows/cloud-native-app/App/Kubernetes/Aws/Kustomization.yaml
    - name: Deploy to EKS (kustomize)
      run: kubectl apply -k .github/workflows/cloud-native-app/App/Kubernetes/Aws
